# 三角洲专属靶场 Demo 0.1

面向《三角洲行动》的本地 WebGL 练枪场原型。首发支持 AS Val、M250、M14、M7，以及四类训练：

- 静态点击
- 平滑/反应追踪
- 多目标切换
- 压枪墙

## 启动

```powershell
npm install
npm run dev
```

浏览器访问终端显示的本地地址。生产构建：

```powershell
npm test
npm run build
```

四枪美术验证页：

```text
/kimi-art-review.html
```

该页面是对 Kimi Code CLI 的 blockout 设计意图进行的浏览器重建，可切换 AS Val、M250、M14、M7，检查 PBR/灰模/黑色剪影、Godot Marker、换弹拆件与程序化动作。它不是 Blender 导出文件，也不代表已经产出正式 GLB、贴图、LOD、骨骼或动画。

参考图返工版已额外导出四个可导入中模 GLB：

```text
public/assets/kimi-v2/asval-kimi-v2.glb
public/assets/kimi-v2/m250-kimi-v2.glb
public/assets/kimi-v2/m14-kimi-v2.glb
public/assets/kimi-v2/m7-kimi-v2.glb
```

这些GLB保留换弹拆件节点，但仍未包含正式UV贴图、LOD、骨骼动画或经过Godot校准的插槽。

## 真实数据链路（ADS / 开火特效）

```text
extracted/weapon_ads.json + weapon_fx.json + fx_curves.json + fx_particles.json
  + parsed/WeaponAppearance_WeaponFiringAnimTable.csv + part_ads_visibility.json
    ── extracted/gen_range_fx.py ──▶ range/src/data/weapon_fx.js（曲线烘焙 64 点 LUT）
```

- `core/ads-motion.js`：每枪 adsOn/adsOff/sideOn/sideOff 秒数驱动 ADS/战术据枪进程，
  adsCurve（枪身位姿）、camFovCurve（相机 FOV 形状）、wpnFovCurve（武器 FOV≈viewmodel 缩放）三路混合；
  机瞄/红点放大率用每枪 zoomRate（多为 1.25）；ADS 过半隐藏 part_ads_visibility 标的小零件。
- `visual/fire_fx.js`：枪口火光（每枪真实贴图，`_MMxNN_` 图集贴图做 subUV 翻页，开镜换 Zoom 版）
  + 瞬时点光、程序化抛壳（池 40）、曳光（按 trailProbability）、镜头抖动（fireShake 曲线/振荡器）、
  枪身后踢（FiringAnim pos/rot 曲线 × ScaleArray 逐发强度，缺失时 gunkick 表回退）。全部对象池化。
- 数据缺失的枪静默回退 `weapon_fx.js` 全局 defaults；openSightOnFire 在已提取的 64 枪中全为 true，未做特殊处理。
- 调试 URL：`?weapon=m7&ads=1`、`?fire=1`（自动连发）、`?fx=0`（关特效）、`?fxhold=1`（火光定格截图）、
  `?laser=1`（无配装强制镭射）、`?clean=1`（隐藏菜单遮罩）。

## 瞄准镜渲染（visual/scope_pip.js）：默认 zoom 全屏放大，PiP 镜内放大为实验项

- **zoom（默认，游戏原版行为）= 全屏 FOV 放大**：开镜后主相机 FOV = hipFov/当前倍率档
  （`zoomAdsFov`，纯函数可测；XM157 1.5×→hipFov/1.5、7×→hipFov/7），DOM 分划叠加居中
  （tickmark 反色+reticle 亮点，SFP 不随档缩放）；单倍红点/机瞄 = hipFov/1.25（真实 zoomRate）。
  变倍：V 键 / 滚轮循环 SupportedZoomRates 档位（两种模式都生效），HUD 底部显示当前倍率；
  灵敏度分档（设置面板分倍镜项）两种模式都按当前倍率档（`currentAdsZoom`）。
- **pip（设置面板「镜内放大（实验）」）**：副相机（眼位、FOV=镜片角直径/当前倍率档）
  渲 WebGLRenderTarget（默认 1024²，设置可调 512/2048），贴在镜片位置的圆形 quad 上——放大画面"长在镜子上"，
  有视差；**主相机不缩 FOV**，镜外世界保持原 FOV、枪身同框。
  分划（tickmark+reticle 贴图，CrosshairPreset 颜色/缩放）合成 additive quad 画进镜内；镜缘暗角径向渐变 quad。
  开火时分划按 sco_pair RandomKick_SightOffset 在镜内跳动（数据 `public/scope_pair_kick.json`，懒加载，缺失回退 55‰）。
- **镜片锚点 = 游戏 socket 数据对位**（不是包围盒估计）：`WeaponPartsMeshSocketNameInfo` 的
  **Center/Eyec_Point** socket（全 103 个瞄具网格都有；PSO 上 Center==Eyec_Point 实证 Center 即目镜光心），
  经 `gunsmith_data.js meshSockets[瞄具网格]` 取用，glb-assembly 解算为装配空间坐标写 `userData.scopeLensCenter`；
  包围盒链（玻璃网格→镜身盒→Sco_point）仅作无数据回退。镜片半径 = 镜片网格在瞄具局部空间横截面 (x+y)/4
  （XM157 玻璃管直径 0.0377 → 0.0189 ≈ ScoFunctionTable ScoRadius 1.81cm；半径字段未导出到 gunsmith_data，故用网格量）。
  ADS mount 用目镜光心 + **ADS 到位缩放**（base×aimWeaponFov/idleWeaponFov）反解——按 base 缩放解会让镜体低
  (1-k)×锚高（M7+XM157 实测低 4.7cm，镜片圆盘浮在镜筒上方的根因）。
  玻璃材质 `depthWrite:false`（否则透明玻璃写深度，镜内 additive 准星点被深度挡掉——红点不可见的根因）。
- **枪×镜 pair 参数**：`gen_range_scopes.py` 将 `sco_pair.json` 按瞄具懒加载写入
  `scopes/{itemId}.json#pairOverrides`；`scope_pip.js` 用当前武器 `recId` 选择组合，已消费
  `FixedOffsetScale`、`LayoutOffsetWPS`、`AimingIdle_SightOffset`，并优先直接使用 pair
  `RandomKick_SightOffset`。其余 Cam/Sight/FOV、逐轴开火动画与 SpringKick 字段已保留在数据包，
  待对应运行时通道完成后继续接线。
- **红点/全息（ZoomRate≤1.25）**：不放大，镜片内 6mm 深处放 additive 准星点（数据无贴图时程序生成，颜色 reticleColor；
  大小 = clamp(reticleScale×0.4, 0.05, 0.12) × 镜片半径），ADS 可见、腰射隐藏；主相机 FOV 按 1.25 缩放（两种模式一致）。
- **分层**：viewmodel（枪身/火光 sprite/镜片 quad 自身）在 layer 1，PiP 副相机只看 layer 0（环境），防反馈回路；
  主相机 0|1 都开。RT 只在 ADS（adsBlend>0.05）且倍镜时每帧渲一次。
- **回退**：RT 创建失败/找不到镜片网格时静默回退 zoom 全屏放大。镜片锚点沿视轴前推（相机嵌入镜身尾部时）
  并按开镜进程收向相机轴线。旧设置值 `dom` 自动迁移为 `zoom`。
- 调试 URL：`?scope=<itemId>`（无枪匠配装也装瞄具，如 13110000082=XM157 / 13110000046=SRS-02红点 / 13110000091=灵眼3/7）、
  `?zstep=N`（变倍档序号）、`?pip=0`（强制 zoom）、`?pip=1`（强制 PiP）、`?pipfov=N`（固定副相机 FOV）、
  `?pipdebug=1`（状态写 DOM，配合 --dump-dom）。

改数据后重建：`python extracted/gen_range_fx.py && cd range && npm run build`。

## 近战刀具系统（melee）

```text
extracted/melee.json（27 近战武器真实连段/距离/装备时间）+ extracted/knife_meshes.json（刀 GLB+贴图）
  ── extracted/gen_range_melee.py ──▶ range/src/data/melee.js（19 把刀；cm→m；NCE 双通道法线离线烘 *_std.png）
```

- `visual/melee_view.js`：刀 GLB（骨骼网格 SkeletonUtils.clone）+ VMGen PBR（BaseColor sRGB / MRA→ORM / 法线，缺贴图深灰金属回退）；
  程序化拔刀（equipTime）、三段连击（attackTime 归一化：蓄力→castTime 判定→过挥→backswing 回收，输入缓冲 0.5s）、
  I 键检视（2.5s，期间锁开火）、待机呼吸微动、挥刀相机 ±0.5° 跟动。
- **原版动画三档**（设置面板「近战动画」/`?meleemode=char|knife|proc`，localStorage 持久化）：
  **人物 char（默认）**=1P 手臂骨架（patched GLB 挂相机，绕 Y180°+(0,-1.6,0) 对齐相机骨）+ AnimationMixer 播原版 clips
  （Fire01-04/GetWeapon/Inspect/IdleLoop），刀挂 `Weapon_RightHand_Joint` 骨随动（identity 标定、缩放 1）。
  **人物模型可选**（设置面板「人物模型」/`?char=hack|dragon|luna|roy|kai|prison|c_test`，清单 `src/data/char_models.js`）：
  6 干员（骇爪/威龙/露娜/罗伊/凯/狱警）= chunk34 HD 模型 `extracted/patch_op_arms.py` 帧系补丁 `_skinned.glb`，
  72 骨与 C_Test_001 全同（动画/挂相机标定通用）；贴图按 GLB 材质槽名接（C+N 恒接，MRA 布局验证过才接 ORM）；

- 鼠标：瞄准
- 左键：射击
- 右键：ADS
- `R`：换弹
- `WASD`：小范围移动
- `Tab` / `Esc`：释放鼠标并打开菜单

菜单和训练输入已经拆分。菜单打开时会强制停止射击、取消ADS、清空移动按键并显示系统鼠标，避免菜单点击被当作准星或开火输入。

灵敏度使用：

- 鼠标 DPI
- cm/360
- 垂直倍率
- ADS 0%显示器距离匹配、相同cm/360或自定义倍率
- ADS FOV系数

设置保存在浏览器本地。该模型直接控制练枪场的实际旋转距离，不冒充已经破解的《三角洲行动》游戏内灵敏度刻度。

四把首发枪现在包含程序化换弹动作：

- AS Val、M14、M7：枪身侧倾、弹匣拆装、拉机柄。

菜单中的“预览当前武器换弹动作”可以在不锁定鼠标的情况下检查动画。当前仍是程序化原型动作，后续会由正式手臂骨骼、枪机、弹链和音效替换。

## 数据可信度

- AS Val 基础伤害 28、M7 基础伤害 37：玩家于当前客户端亲自确认。
- 其余公开基础数据：社区/数据库交叉整理，仍需游戏内逐项核验。
- Demo 的操控时间和逐发后坐轨迹：明确标记为候选/合成参数，仅用于让训练链路可玩，不冒充《三角洲行动》实测值。
- 伤害衰减采用平滑候选曲线；后续可直接替换为分段实测表。

## 模型策略

当前版本使用原创程序化模块模型，不包含任何游戏客户端提取资产：

- AS Val：一体式长消音器、弧形弹匣、折叠骨架托
- M250：供弹盖、侧挂弹箱、长机枪护木和两脚架
- M14：M14 机匣、EBR 底盘、长枪管
- M7：MCX/SPEAR 机匣、沙色护木、折叠托和消音器

模型共享金属、聚合物、橡胶、玻璃的材质语言，后续可通过同一 `buildWeaponModel` 接口替换为完成授权下载和二次改造的 GLB。

const baseUrl = globalThis.document?.baseURI ?? import.meta.url;
export const FX_MANIFEST_URL = new URL("fx/fx_config.json", baseUrl);

function deepFreeze(value, seen = new WeakSet()) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || seen.has(value)) return value;
  seen.add(value);
  for (const child of Object.values(value)) deepFreeze(child, seen);
  return Object.freeze(value);
}

function assertManifest(config, url) {
  if (!config || config.schema !== "range.fx/v1") {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported FX manifest schema: ${config?.schema ?? "missing"} (${url})`);
  }
  if (!config.weapon || !config.skills?.profiles || !config.skills?.runtime) {
    throw new Error(`Incomplete FX manifest: weapon/skills.profiles/skills.runtime are required (${url})`);
  }
  if (!Object.keys(config.skills.profiles).length) {
    throw new Error(`FX manifest has no skill profiles (${url})`);
  }
  return config;
}

async function loadManifest() {
  const response = await fetch(FX_MANIFEST_URL, { cache: "no-store" });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`FX manifest load failed: ${response.status} ${FX_MANIFEST_URL}`);
  }
  return assertManifest(await response.json(), FX_MANIFEST_URL);
}

export const FX_CONFIG = deepFreeze(await loadManifest());
export const FX_MANIFEST_META = deepFreeze({
  schema: FX_CONFIG.schema,
  generatedAt: FX_CONFIG.generatedAt ?? null,
  generator: FX_CONFIG.generator ?? null,
  url: FX_MANIFEST_URL.href,
});
export const WEAPON_FX_RUNTIME = FX_CONFIG.weapon;
export const SKILL_FX_RUNTIME = FX_CONFIG.skills.runtime;
export const SKILL_FX_PROFILES = FX_CONFIG.skills.profiles;

// 皮肤 key → manifest profile。默认皮不得返回 null：只有这样所有正常技能路径都能保证使用
// 原版解包贴图，而不是退回到旧的 SphereGeometry/颜色球占位效果。
export function skillFxProfileFor(charKey) {
  return SKILL_FX_PROFILES[charKey]
    ?? SKILL_FX_PROFILES.luna
    ?? Object.values(SKILL_FX_PROFILES)[0]
    ?? null;
}

export function skillFxRuntimeFor(name) {
  return SKILL_FX_RUNTIME[name] ?? null;
}

if (globalThis.window) {

  globalThis.window.__fxManifest = FX_MANIFEST_META;

// ---- 俯仰/后坐状态机（core/pitch-control.js，Bug1 压枪下拉修复回归）----
const { PITCH_LIMIT, applyMousePitch, clampVisualPitch, integrateRecoil, queueRecoilShot, visualPitch } =
  await import("../src/core/pitch-control.js");
{
  const DEG = 180 / Math.PI;
  const mk = () => ({ pitch: 0, recoilPitch: 0, recoilYaw: 0, recoilVelocityPitch: 0, recoilVelocityYaw: 0 });
  // 单元：限位内鼠标输入全量作用于 pitch
  {
    const st = mk();
    applyMousePitch(st, 10 / DEG);
    clampVisualPitch(st);
    assert.ok(Math.abs(st.pitch * DEG - 10) < 1e-9 && st.recoilPitch === 0, "限位内上抬 10°");
    applyMousePitch(st, -25 / DEG);
    clampVisualPitch(st);
    assert.ok(Math.abs(visualPitch(st) * DEG + 15) < 1e-9, "限位内下拉 25°");
  }
  // 单元：pitch 触限后剩余量冲抵 recoilPitch（下拉永远生效）
  {
    const st = mk();
    st.pitch = -PITCH_LIMIT;
    st.recoilPitch = 179.8 / DEG; // 视觉朝天（压枪后 pitch 钉底、后坐顶到限位的典型状态）
    clampVisualPitch(st);
    assert.ok(Math.abs(visualPitch(st) - PITCH_LIMIT) < 1e-6, "预置：视觉 +89.9°");
    applyMousePitch(st, -30 / DEG);
    clampVisualPitch(st);
    assert.ok(Math.abs(visualPitch(st) * DEG - 59.9) < 1e-6, "朝天时下拉 30° 视觉实降 30°（旧实现降 0°）");
    assert.ok(Math.abs(st.pitch + PITCH_LIMIT) < 1e-9, "pitch 保持下限（输入转冲 recoilPitch）");
    assert.ok(Math.abs(st.recoilPitch * DEG - 149.8) < 1e-6, "recoilPitch 被手压回 30°");
    // 视觉钳制只削 recoilPitch、永不动 pitch
    applyMousePitch(st, 200 / DEG);
    clampVisualPitch(st);
    assert.ok(visualPitch(st) <= PITCH_LIMIT + 1e-9, "猛抬不超过 +89.9°");
  }
  // 集成：缓动注入与 CameraRecover 同帧运行，停火后收敛到 FixN 残留；鼠标仍可直接压回。
  {
    const st = mk();
    const recover = WEAPONS.m7.recoilRuntime.recover;
    queueRecoilShot(st, {
      pitchDeg: 10,
      yawDeg: 0,
      easeTime: 0.0924,
      pitchEase: "EaseOutExpo",
      yawEase: "EaseOutExpo",
      recover,
      resetSequence: true,
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < 480; i++) integrateRecoil(st, 1 / 480);
    assert.ok(Math.abs(st.recoilPitch * DEG - 10 * recover.PitchFixN) < 0.02, "停火后收敛到 FixN 残留");
    const v0 = visualPitch(st);
    applyMousePitch(st, -0.3 / DEG);
    clampVisualPitch(st);
    assert.ok(Math.abs((v0 - visualPitch(st)) * DEG - 0.3) < 0.01, "鼠标下拉直接作用于真实后坐残留");
  }
}

  onImpact(point, normal = null, surface = "generic") {
    if (!this.enabled || !point || !this.impacts.length) return;
    const hit = this.impacts[this.impactCursor++ % this.impacts.length];
    const cfg = this.config.impact;
    hit.active = true;
    hit.t = 0;
    hit.surface = surface;
    hit.sprite.position.copy(point);
    if (normal) hit.sprite.position.addScaledVector(normal, 0.01);
    hit.sprite.scale.setScalar(cfg.sizeM);
    hit.mat.opacity = cfg.opacity;
    hit.sprite.visible = true;
  }

  update(dt, now) {
    const out = this._out;
    out.shake.pitch = out.shake.yaw = out.shake.roll = 0;
    out.kick.pos.x = out.kick.pos.y = out.kick.pos.z = 0;
    out.kick.rot.x = out.kick.rot.y = out.kick.rot.z = 0;
    this._updateFlashes(dt);
    this._updateShells(dt);
    this._updateTracers(dt);
    this._updateImpacts(dt);
    if (this.enabled) {
      this._updateShake(now, out.shake);
      this._updateKick(now, out.kick);
    }
    return out;
  }

  _updateFlashes(dt) {
    for (const f of this.flashes) {
      if (!f.active) continue;
      f.t += dt;
      if (f.t >= f.ttl) {
        f.active = false;
        f.sprite.visible = false;
        f.mat.opacity = 0;
        continue;
      }
      const k = f.t / f.ttl;
      f.mat.opacity = this.config.muzzle.opacity * (1 - k * k);
      const frames = f.set.cols * f.set.rows;
      const frame = (f.frame0 + ((k * frames) | 0)) % frames;
      f.mat.map.offset.set((frame % f.set.cols) / f.set.cols, 1 - (Math.floor(frame / f.set.cols) + 1) / f.set.rows);
      f.mat.map.repeat.set(1 / f.set.cols, 1 / f.set.rows);
      f.sprite.scale.setScalar((f.size * (1 + k * this.config.muzzle.expand)) / (f.worldScale || 1));
    }
    if (this.light.intensity > 0) {
      this.lightT += dt;
      const cfg = this.config.muzzle.light;
      this.light.intensity = Math.max(0, cfg.intensity * (1 - this.lightT / cfg.durationSec));
    }
  }

  _updateShells(dt) {
    for (const s of this.shells) {
      if (!s.active) continue;
      s.life -= dt;
      if (s.life <= 0) {
        s.active = false;
        s.mesh.visible = false;
        continue;
      }
      s.vel.y += this.config.shell.gravityMps2 * dt;
      s.mesh.position.addScaledVector(s.vel, dt);
      if (s.mesh.position.y < 0.012 && s.vel.y < 0) {

        s.mesh.position.y = 0.012;
      }
      s.mesh.rotation.x += s.rot.x * dt;
      s.mesh.rotation.y += s.rot.y * dt;
      s.mesh.rotation.z += s.rot.z * dt;
    }
  }

  _updateTracers(dt) {
    for (const tr of this.tracers) {
      if (!tr.active) continue;
      tr.t += dt;
      if (tr.t >= tr.ttl) {
        tr.active = false;
        tr.group.visible = false;

      tr.group.position.addScaledVector(tr.dir, -len / 2);

  _updateImpacts(dt) {
    const cfg = this.config.impact;
    for (const hit of this.impacts) {
      if (!hit.active) continue;
      hit.t += dt;
      const k = hit.t / cfg.durationSec;
      if (k >= 1) {
        hit.active = false;
        hit.sprite.visible = false;
        hit.mat.opacity = 0;
        continue;
      }
      hit.sprite.scale.setScalar(cfg.sizeM * (1 + cfg.expand * k));
      hit.mat.opacity = cfg.opacity * (1 - k);
    }
  }

  probeSnapshot() {

    const activeTracer = this.tracers.find((x) => x.active) || this.tracers[0] || null;

        shell: this.shells.length,

      muzzle: activeFlash ? {

        color: `#${activeFlash.mat.color.getHexString()}`,

  _updateShake(now, shake) {

    const t = (now - this.shakeState.start) / 1000;
    const dur = data.duration || 0.5;
    if (t < 0 || t >= dur) return;
    let env = 1;
    if (data.blendIn > 0 && t < data.blendIn) env = t / data.blendIn;
    if (data.blendOut > 0 && t > dur - data.blendOut) env = Math.min(env, (dur - t) / data.blendOut);

export class ParticleTrail {
  constructor({
    texture, maxParticles = 96, rate = 48, sourceRate = rate,
    lifeMin = 0.35, lifeMax = 0.8, size = 0.08,
    tint = 0xffffff, opacity = 0.85, blending = THREE.AdditiveBlending,

    acceleration = new THREE.Vector3(),

    this.maxParticles = maxParticles;

    this.lifeMin = lifeMin;
    this.lifeMax = lifeMax;
    this.spread = spread;
    this.speedMin = speedMin;
    this.speedMax = speedMax;
    this.acceleration = acceleration.clone();
    this.spawnCarry = 0;
    this.cursor = 0;
    this.age = new Float32Array(maxParticles);
    this.life = new Float32Array(maxParticles);
    this.vel = new Float32Array(maxParticles * 3);
    const pos = new Float32Array(maxParticles * 3);
    pos.fill(1e6);
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    this.geo = geo;
    this.mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
      map: texture, color: new THREE.Color(tint), transparent: true,
      opacity, blending, depthWrite: false, size, sizeAttenuation: true,
    });
    this.points = new THREE.Points(geo, this.mat);
    this.points.frustumCulled = false;
    this.points.userData.sourceRate = sourceRate;
    this.sprite = this.points;
  }

  _spawn(origin, inheritedVelocity) {
    const i = this.cursor;
    this.cursor = (this.cursor + 1) % this.maxParticles;
    this.age[i] = 0.0001;
    this.life[i] = this.lifeMin + Math.random() * (this.lifeMax - this.lifeMin);
    const p = this.geo.attributes.position;
    p.setXYZ(
      i,
      origin.x + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * this.spread,
      origin.y + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * this.spread,
      origin.z + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * this.spread
    );
    const u = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const planar = Math.sqrt(1 - u * u);
    const speed = this.speedMin + Math.random() * (this.speedMax - this.speedMin);
    this.vel[i * 3] = planar * Math.cos(a) * speed + (inheritedVelocity?.x ?? 0);
    this.vel[i * 3 + 1] = u * speed + (inheritedVelocity?.y ?? 0);
    this.vel[i * 3 + 2] = planar * Math.sin(a) * speed + (inheritedVelocity?.z ?? 0);
  }

  update(dt, origin, inheritedVelocity = null) {
    this.spawnCarry += dt * this.rate;
    const count = Math.min(this.maxParticles, Math.floor(this.spawnCarry));
    this.spawnCarry -= count;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) this._spawn(origin, inheritedVelocity);
    const p = this.geo.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.maxParticles; i++) {
      if (this.age[i] <= 0) continue;
      this.age[i] += dt;
      if (this.age[i] >= this.life[i]) {
        this.age[i] = 0;
        p.setXYZ(i, 1e6, 1e6, 1e6);
        continue;
      }
      this.vel[i * 3] += this.acceleration.x * dt;
      this.vel[i * 3 + 1] += this.acceleration.y * dt;
      this.vel[i * 3 + 2] += this.acceleration.z * dt;
      p.setXYZ(
        i,
        p.getX(i) + this.vel[i * 3] * dt,
        p.getY(i) + this.vel[i * 3 + 1] * dt,
        p.getZ(i) + this.vel[i * 3 + 2] * dt
      );
    }
    p.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  dispose() {
    this.points.removeFromParent();
    this.geo.dispose();
    this.mat.dispose();
  }

  constructor({

    const uv = new Float32Array(vertCount * 2);
    const index = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= this.segments; i++) {
      const u = i / this.segments;
      uv[(i * 2) * 2] = u;
      uv[(i * 2) * 2 + 1] = 1;
      uv[(i * 2 + 1) * 2] = u;
      uv[(i * 2 + 1) * 2 + 1] = 0;

      _lsPoint.copy(start).lerp(end, k);

  _waitForAllTexturesThenCompile(warmCamera, existingRoots, countVisibleLights, warmupCanvasRender) {

  _warmupTick(warmCamera, existingRoots, countVisibleLights, warmupCanvasRender) {

    const needMore = pending > 0 || this._warmupTickCount < 6; // 至少 6 轮 ≈ 1s
    if (needMore && performance.now() < this._fxWarmupDeadline) {

  _finishFxWarmup(warmCamera, existingRoots, countVisibleLights, warmupCanvasRender) {
    warmupCanvasRender();
    const warmupRoots = this.scene.children.filter((child) => !existingRoots.has(child));
    for (const child of warmupRoots) child.userData._fxWarmup = true;
    const explosionLight = this.scene.getObjectByName("FX_ExplosionLight");
    const warmFields = this.fields.filter((f) => f._fxWarmup);
    if (explosionLight) explosionLight.visible = false;
    warmupCanvasRender();
    for (const f of warmFields) if (f.light) f.light.visible = false;
    warmupCanvasRender();
    if (explosionLight) explosionLight.visible = true;
    for (const f of warmFields) if (f.light) f.light.visible = true;
    this.renderer.compile(this.scene, warmCamera);
    for (const child of warmupRoots) child.visible = false;
    if (this.camera) {
      const oldClear = this.renderer.getClearColor(new THREE.Color()).clone();
      const oldAlpha = this.renderer.getClearAlpha();
      this.renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 1);
      this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
      this.renderer.compile(this.scene, this.camera);
      this.renderer.setClearColor(oldClear, oldAlpha);

      child.removeFromParent();
      this._disposeRecursive(child);
    }

    this.fields = this.fields.filter((f) => !f._fxWarmup);

      const s = this.scans[i];
      s.lineFx?.update(dt);
      s.nextPulse -= dt;
      if (nowS < s.until && s.nextPulse <= 0 && (s.pulsesLeft === null || s.pulsesLeft > 0)) {
        if (s.pulsesLeft !== null) s.pulsesLeft -= 1;
        s.nextPulse = s.def.interval;
        this._scanPulse(s.pos, this._scanRadiusAt(s.pos.y, s.def), s.def);
      }
      if (nowS >= s.removeAt) {
        s.lineFx?.dispose();
        this.scene.remove(s.mesh);
        this.scans.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // P_EFX_Lighting_Luna_Single_01_HD：使用 manifest 中的 Energy_17 与寿命/宽度。
  // 同一原语既用于插箭瞬间向外放电，也用于每次电场命中目标；后者补齐此前“只掉血、不放电”的占位路径。
  _spawnLightningBurst(start, end, cfg, { count = cfg?.count ?? 1, opacity = 1, jitter = 0.2 } = {}) {
    if (!cfg?.url || !start || !end) return;
    const lifeMin = cfg.lifeMin ?? 0.2;
    const lifeMax = cfg.lifeMax ?? lifeMin;
    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
      const strip = new LightningStrip({
        texture: fxTexture(cfg.url, cfg.mode ?? "raw"),
        tint: cfg.tint ?? 0xffffff,
        width: cfg.width ?? 0.12,
        opacity,
        segments: 9,
        jitter,
      });
      const arcEnd = end.clone();
      if (k > 0) {
        arcEnd.x += (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.16;
        arcEnd.y += (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.12;
        arcEnd.z += (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.16;
      }
      strip.update(start, arcEnd, this.camera, 1);
      this.scene.add(strip.mesh);
      const life = lifeMin + Math.random() * Math.max(0, lifeMax - lifeMin);
      this.effects.push({
        t: 0,
        dur: life,
        update: (q) => { strip.mat.opacity = opacity * (1 - q); },
        done: () => strip.dispose(),
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- 电击箭矢：插箭 → 持续电场，周期跳伤害 ----------
  // P_Scout_Arrow_Lighting_Trail_Line_HD（地面线）+
  // P_EFX_Beam_Lightning_Luna_Black_01_HD（Smoke/Stones/Brush/Beam2）+
  // P_EFX_Lighting_Luna_Single_01_HD（命中瞬间双闪电）。
  _startField(p) {
    const def = p.def.field;
    // LeftTime=4.0s；黏到角色 LifeTime_StickyToChar=3.0s（BP_FireArrowActor CDO）
    const dur = p.stuckTarget ? (def.stickyDuration ?? def.duration) : def.duration;
    const fx = this._fxSet()?.field;
    const rt = this.fxRuntime.shockField;
    const pos = p.mesh.position.clone();
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    group.name = "FX_ShockField";
    group.position.copy(pos);
    const ringColor = fx?.ring ?? 0x4d8fff;
    const ring = new THREE.Mesh(
      fieldRingGeo(def.radius),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        map: fx?.energy ? fxTexture(fx.energy.url, fx.energy.mode ?? "lumaAlpha") : null,
        color: ringColor, transparent: true, opacity: rt.ringOpacity,
        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false,
      })
    );
    ring.name = "FX_ShockRing";
    ring.castShadow = false;
    ring.userData.fxKind = "shockRing";
    ring.userData.fxConfig = rt;
    ring.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ring.position.y = Math.max(0.06, 0.06 - pos.y); // 环始终贴地（箭插在靶上时也一样）
    group.add(ring);
    // 箭矢飞行灯直接移交电场；没有飞行灯的调试路径才从对象池取。
    let light = p.mesh.userData.effectLight;
    if (light) {
      p.mesh.remove(light);
      p.mesh.userData.effectLight = null;
    } else {
      light = this._acquireEffectLight(
        fx?.light ?? 0x4d8fff,
        rt.lightIntensity,
        def.radius * rt.lightDistanceRadiusScale,
        rt.lightDecay
      );
    }
    light.color.set(fx?.light ?? 0x4d8fff);
    light.intensity = rt.lightIntensity;
    light.distance = def.radius * rt.lightDistanceRadiusScale;
    light.decay = rt.lightDecay;
    light.name = "FX_ShockLight";
    light.castShadow = false;
    light.userData.fxKind = "shockLight";
    light.userData.fxConfig = rt;
    light.position.y = Math.max(0.5, 0.5 - pos.y);
    group.add(light);
    const groundY = Math.max(0.08, 0.08 - pos.y);
    const bolts = [];
    let glow = null;
    if (fx) {
      // Beam2：Fast_6（10/s）+ Beem_01（2/s）；网页端保留 6+2 条并按原寿命频率抖动。
      for (const [kind, beam] of [["beam", fx.beamFast], ["beam", fx.beamMain]]) {
        if (!beam) continue;
        for (let k = 0; k < (beam.count ?? 0); k++) {
          const strip = new LightningStrip({
            texture: fxTexture(beam.url, beam.mode ?? "raw"),
            tint: fx.tint, width: beam.width, opacity: beam.opacity,
            segments: kind === "beam" ? 8 : 6, jitter: 0.16,
          });
          this.scene.add(strip.mesh);
          bolts.push({ strip, kind, refresh: 0, interval: 0.1, opacity: beam.opacity ?? 0.8 });
        }
      }
      // Lighting_Trail_Line：20/s、寿命 0.8s，地面保留 5 条循环刷新。
      const impact = this._fxSet()?.shockImpact;
      if (impact) {
        for (let k = 0; k < (impact.count ?? 5); k++) {
          const strip = new LightningStrip({
            texture: fxTexture(impact.url, impact.mode ?? "raw"),
            tint: impact.tint, width: impact.width, opacity: 0.72,
            segments: 9, jitter: 0.22,
          });
          this.scene.add(strip.mesh);
          bolts.push({
            strip, kind: "ground", refresh: 0,
            interval: impact.refresh ?? 0.05, opacity: 0.72,
            radius: impact.radius ?? def.radius,
          });
        }
      }
      // Energy_17 同时是 Fast Lightning 的 distortion texture，用作场心能量底纹。
      glow = new THREE.Mesh(flatGeo(), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        map: fxTexture(fx.energy.url, fx.energy.mode ?? "lumaAlpha"),
        color: new THREE.Color(fx.tint), transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.3, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      }));
      glow.position.y = groundY - 0.02;
      glow.scale.set(def.radius, 1, def.radius);
      group.add(glow);

      // Smoke：6×6 SubUV，寿命 0.8~1.5s；场启动时播一团（原 rate=0，系统激活视作外部触发）。
      if (fx.smoke) {
        const s = fx.smoke;
        const smoke = new Flipbook({
          texture: fxTexture(s.url, s.mode ?? "raw"),
          cols: s.cols, rows: s.rows, frames: s.frames, fps: s.fps,
          size: s.size, tint: s.tint, opacity: s.opacity,
          blending: THREE.NormalBlending, fadeTail: 0.5, rise: s.rise ?? 0,
        });
        smoke.sprite.position.set(pos.x, Math.max(0.6, pos.y + 0.6), pos.z);
        this.scene.add(smoke.sprite);
        this.effects.push({ t: 0, dur: smoke.life, update: (k) => smoke.setProgress(k), done: () => smoke.dispose() });
      }
      // Brush：0.1~0.2s 短促贴地刷痕。
      if (fx.brush) {
        const b = fx.brush;
        const brush = new THREE.Mesh(flatGeo(), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          map: fxTexture(b.url, b.mode ?? "raw"), color: new THREE.Color(b.tint),
          transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
          depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        }));
        brush.position.set(pos.x, 0.09, pos.z);
        this.scene.add(brush);
        this.effects.push({
          t: 0, dur: b.life ?? 0.16,
          update: (k) => {
            const scale = (b.size ?? 0.55) * (0.7 + k * 1.1);
            brush.scale.set(scale, 1, scale);
            brush.material.opacity = 0.85 * (1 - k);
          },
          done: () => { brush.removeFromParent(); brush.material.dispose(); },
        });
      }
      // Stones：原 rate=0、无 burst，场启动时低采样一次；重力按 -980cm/s² → -9.8m/s²。
      if (fx.stones) {
        const s = fx.stones;
        const stones = new SparkBurst({
          texture: fxTexture(s.url, s.mode ?? "raw"), count: s.count,
          tint: s.tint, size: s.size, speedMin: 0.4, speedMax: 1.2,
          life: s.life, gravity: -9.8,
        });
        stones.sprite.position.copy(pos);
        this.scene.add(stones.sprite);
        this.effects.push({ t: 0, dur: stones.life, update: (k) => stones.setProgress(k), done: () => stones.dispose(), pooled: true });
      }

      // 单闪电：两张 Houdini lightning mesh 在命中帧各爆发一次，寿命 0.2~0.3s。
      const single = this._fxSet()?.singleLightning;
      if (single) {
        for (let k = 0; k < (single.count ?? 2); k++) {
          const start = pos.clone();
          start.y = Math.max(0.1, start.y);
          const a = k * Math.PI + Math.random() * 0.8;
          const end = start.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(
            Math.cos(a) * (single.length ?? 5) * 0.45,
            (single.length ?? 5) * (0.55 + Math.random() * 0.35),
            Math.sin(a) * (single.length ?? 5) * 0.45
          ));
          this._spawnLightningBurst(start, end, single, { count: 1, opacity: 1, jitter: 0.24 });
        }
      }
    }
    this.scene.add(group);
    group.userData.fxKind = "shockField";
    group.userData.fxConfig = {
      ringColor: `#${new THREE.Color(ringColor).getHexString()}`,
      ringOpacity: rt.ringOpacity,
      lightIntensity: rt.lightIntensity,
      durationSec: dur,
      castShadow: light.castShadow,
    };
    this.fields.push({
      group, ring, light, bolts, glow, def, origin: pos, groundY,
      until: performance.now() / 1000 + dur,
      nextTick: 0,
      arrow: p.mesh,
    });
    if (!this._fxWarming) this.callbacks.toast?.("电击箭矢已部署");
  }

  _updateFields(dt) {
    if (!this.fields.length) return;
    const nowS = performance.now() / 1000;
    const targets = this.callbacks.getTargets?.() ?? [];
    for (let i = this.fields.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const f = this.fields[i];
      for (const bolt of f.bolts) {
        bolt.refresh -= dt;
        if (bolt.refresh > 0) continue;
        bolt.refresh = bolt.interval;
        const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const len = (bolt.radius ?? f.def.radius) * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.55);
        this._tmpV.set(f.origin.x, bolt.kind === "ground" ? 0.09 : Math.max(0.1, f.origin.y), f.origin.z);
        if (bolt.kind === "ground") {
          this._tmpV2.set(
            f.origin.x + Math.cos(ang) * len,
            0.09 + Math.random() * 0.08,
            f.origin.z + Math.sin(ang) * len
          );
        } else {
          this._tmpV2.set(
            f.origin.x + Math.cos(ang) * len,
            Math.max(0.4, f.origin.y + 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.2),
            f.origin.z + Math.sin(ang) * len
          );
        }
        bolt.strip.update(this._tmpV, this._tmpV2, this.camera, 1);
        bolt.strip.mesh.visible = Math.random() > 0.18;
        bolt.strip.mat.opacity = bolt.opacity * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);
      }
      if (f.glow) {
        f.glow.rotation.y += dt * 0.6;
        f.glow.material.opacity = 0.26 + 0.14 * Math.sin(nowS * 18);
      }
      if (f.light) f.light.intensity = 2.2 + 1.4 * Math.abs(Math.sin(nowS * 23));
      // 周期伤害
      f.nextTick -= dt;
      if (f.nextTick <= 0) {
        f.nextTick = f.def.tickInterval;
--- explosion ---
      if (nowS >= f.until) {
        this._disposeFieldFx(f);
        this.scene.remove(f.group);
        this.scene.remove(f.arrow);
        this.fields.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- 破片手雷：引信到 → 爆炸 + 半径衰减伤害 ----------
  // 贴图化（发射器搭配出自 fx_m67_explode.json dump）：Ci_01 主体 + Ci_02 碎片 + Cannon_Fire_08 火光
  // + Flash_01 爆闪 + SmokeSubUV 6×6 余烟 + Spark_sai_01/Glow_15 火花散射；
  // 地爆加 LoopSmoke_FBEA_v01 环状烟尘 10 团，空爆换 Mask_75/Glow_1 大辉光（爆点 y>0.35m 判空爆）；
  // 尺寸按 radius=8m 比例；红皮 tint 见 runtime manifest profile。
  _explode(p) {
    const def = p.def.explosion;
    const pos = p.mesh.position.clone();
    const fx = this._fxSet()?.explosion;
    const rt = this.fxRuntime.explosion;
    const light = this._acquireEffectLight(
      fx?.light ?? 0xffb36b,
      rt.lightIntensity,
      def.radius * rt.lightDistanceRadiusScale,
      rt.lightDecay
    );
    light.name = "FX_ExplosionLight";
    light.castShadow = false;
    light.userData.fxKind = "explosionLight";
    light.userData.fxConfig = rt;
    light.position.copy(pos);
    light.position.y += 0.4;
    this.scene.add(light);
    // 点光衰减（两皮共用）
    this.effects.push({
      t: 0, dur: rt.lightDurationSec,
      update: (k) => { light.intensity = rt.lightIntensity * (1 - k); },
      done: () => this._releaseEffectLight(light),
    });
    if (fx) {
      const R = def.radius;
      // 空爆/地爆变体选择（WeaponThrowableFXTable：水泥/空气两变体；黑皮 Explode/Aerial 两系统）：
      // 手雷静止在地面时 y≈0.05，爆点高于 0.35m 即按空爆处理
      const air = pos.y > rt.groundThresholdM;
      const parts = [
        // 爆闪火光（单帧闪光，0.16s）
        new TintedBillboard({ texture: fxTexture(fx.flash.url), size: R * 1.7, tint: fx.flash.tint, life: 0.16, grow: 0.6 }),
        // 火光序列帧（Cannon_Fire_08，黑底 additive 原图直用）
        new Flipbook({ texture: fxTexture(fx.fire.url), cols: fx.fire.cols, rows: fx.fire.rows, frames: fx.fire.frames, fps: fx.fire.fps, size: R * 1.5, tint: fx.fire.tint, fadeTail: 0.15 }),
        // 爆炸主体烟尘（Ci_01，白/alpha 通道 → whiteAlpha 后 tint 上色）
        new Flipbook({ texture: fxTexture(fx.main.url, "whiteAlpha"), cols: fx.main.cols, rows: fx.main.rows, frames: fx.main.frames, fps: fx.main.fps, size: R * 1.15, tint: fx.main.tint, blending: THREE.NormalBlending, opacity: 0.92, fadeTail: 0.35, rise: 0.8 }),
        // 冲击碎片/火花（Ci_02，同 whiteAlpha 处理，亮色 additive）
        new Flipbook({ texture: fxTexture(fx.debris.url, "whiteAlpha"), cols: fx.debris.cols, rows: fx.debris.rows, frames: fx.debris.frames, fps: fx.debris.fps, size: R * 1.0, tint: fx.debris.tint, fadeTail: 0.25 }),
        // 余烟（SmokeSubUV 6×6，慢速上飘）
        new Flipbook({ texture: fxTexture(fx.smoke.url), cols: fx.smoke.cols, rows: fx.smoke.rows, frames: fx.smoke.frames, fps: fx.smoke.fps, size: R * 1.35, tint: fx.smoke.tint, blending: THREE.NormalBlending, opacity: 0.7, fadeTail: 0.5, rise: 1.6 }),
        // 火花散射（Sparks Cloud：Spark_sai_01 / Glow_15，两皮共用结构）
        new SparkBurst({ texture: fxTexture(fx.sparks.url), tint: fx.sparks.tint, count: 42, speedMin: 6, speedMax: air ? 20 : 14, life: 0.5 }),
      ];
      if (air && fx.airGlow) {
        // 空爆大辉光（原皮 Mask_75 / 黑皮 Glow_1，原尺寸 12-15m）
        parts.push(new TintedBillboard({ texture: fxTexture(fx.airGlow.url), size: R * 1.9, tint: fx.airGlow.tint, life: 0.15, grow: 0.25 }));
      }
      if (air && fx.aerial) {
        // P_EFX_Explode_Aerial_Luna_Black_01_HD：Ci_02_F 双烟环、Body KAI、
        // Triangle/Rock 云、Glow_1 ignition、Noise_06 球壳、Hash_01 残留闪电。
        const a = fx.aerial;
        parts.push(
          new Flipbook({
            texture: fxTexture(a.smokeFire.url, a.smokeFire.mode ?? "raw"),
            cols: a.smokeFire.cols, rows: a.smokeFire.rows,
            frames: a.smokeFire.frames, fps: a.smokeFire.fps,
            size: R * 1.25, tint: a.smokeFire.tint,
            blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, opacity: 0.82, fadeTail: 0.3,
          }),
          new Flipbook({
            texture: fxTexture(a.body.url, a.body.mode ?? "raw"),
            cols: a.body.cols, rows: a.body.rows,
            frames: a.body.frames, fps: a.body.fps,
            size: R * 0.62, tint: a.body.tint,
            blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, opacity: 0.75, fadeTail: 0.45, rise: -0.4,
          }),
          new SparkBurst({
            texture: fxTexture(a.triangle.url, a.triangle.mode ?? "raw"),
            tint: a.triangle.tint, count: a.triangle.count,
            size: 0.24, speedMin: 0.6, speedMax: 2.2, life: 0.8, gravity: -1,
          }),
          new SparkBurst({
            texture: fxTexture(a.rock.url, a.rock.mode ?? "raw"),
            tint: a.rock.tint, count: a.rock.count,
            size: 0.18, speedMin: 2.0, speedMax: 5.0, life: 2.2, gravity: -10,
          }),
          new TintedBillboard({
            texture: fxTexture(a.ignition.url, a.ignition.mode ?? "raw"),
            size: R * 0.9, tint: a.ignition.tint, life: 0.08, grow: 0.2,
          }),
          new TintedBillboard({
            texture: fxTexture(a.ball.url, a.ball.mode ?? "lumaAlpha"),
            size: R * 0.52, tint: a.ball.tint, life: 0.3, grow: 0.7,
          }),
          new TintedBillboard({
            texture: fxTexture(a.sphere.url, a.sphere.mode ?? "lumaAlpha"),
            size: R * 0.58, tint: a.sphere.tint, life: 0.15, grow: 1.1,
          }),
        );
        // Lighting_E_canliu：5+3 爆发，网页端合并成 5 条 0.25~0.5s 的折线残电。
        for (let i = 0; i < (a.residual.count ?? 5); i++) {
          const strip = new LightningStrip({
            texture: fxTexture(a.residual.url, a.residual.mode ?? "lumaAlpha"),
            tint: a.residual.tint, width: 0.12, opacity: 0.9,
            segments: 8, jitter: 0.35,
          });
          const start = pos.clone();
          const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const end = pos.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(
            Math.cos(ang) * R * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.45),
            (Math.random() * 2 - 0.5) * R * 0.35,
            Math.sin(ang) * R * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.45)
          ));
          strip.update(start, end, this.camera, 1);
          this.scene.add(strip.mesh);
          this.effects.push({
            t: 0, dur: 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.25,
            update: (k) => { strip.mat.opacity = 0.9 * (1 - k); },
            done: () => strip.dispose(),
          });
        }
      }
      if (!air && fx.groundSmoke) {
        // 地爆环状烟尘（Bust_Gound_HouSmoke：爆发 10 团 LoopSmoke 8×8，环绕爆心铺开）
        const ring = 10;
        for (let i = 0; i < ring; i++) {
          const a = (i / ring) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.5;
          const puff = new Flipbook({
            texture: fxTexture(fx.groundSmoke.url), cols: fx.groundSmoke.cols, rows: fx.groundSmoke.rows,
            frames: fx.groundSmoke.frames, fps: fx.groundSmoke.fps,
            size: R * 0.42, tint: fx.groundSmoke.tint,
            blending: THREE.NormalBlending, opacity: 0.55, fadeTail: 0.45,
          });
          puff.sprite.position.set(pos.x + Math.cos(a) * R * 0.3, 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3, pos.z + Math.sin(a) * R * 0.3);
          this.scene.add(puff.sprite);
          this.effects.push({ t: 0, dur: puff.life, update: (k) => puff.setProgress(k), done: () => puff.dispose() });
        }
      }
      for (const part of parts) {
        part.sprite.position.copy(pos);
        part.sprite.position.y += part === parts[0] ? 0.6 : 0.9;
        this.scene.add(part.sprite);
        this.effects.push({
          t: 0, dur: part.life,
          update: (k) => part.setProgress(k),
          done: () => part.dispose(),
          pooled: part instanceof SparkBurst,
        });
      }
    } else if (!this._fxWarming) {
      // 同上：manifest 异常时保留伤害逻辑和诊断，但不显示颜色球占位特效。
      console.warn("[skills] grenade FX skipped: missing manifest profile", this.charKey);
    }
    for (const t of this.callbacks.getTargets?.() ?? []) {
      const chest = new THREE.Vector3(t.position.x, t.position.y + 1.1, t.position.z);
      const d = chest.distanceTo(pos);
      if (d > def.radius) continue;
      // DamageExplodeValue 27：全额半径 2m 内 110，向外到 8m 线性衰减至 1
      const span = Math.max(0.001, def.radius - (def.fullRadius ?? 0));
      const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (d - (def.fullRadius ?? 0)) / span));
      const dmg = def.maxDamage + (def.minDamage - def.maxDamage) * k;
      this.callbacks.applyDamage?.(t, dmg, chest, 1982066); // 增强破片手雷 AttackerValue（不在被动加时名单）
    }
  }

  // 无头探针入口：不改机制触发文件，直接在相机前方生成同一套运行时 FX。
  // kind: "shock" | "explosion"
  debugSpawnFx(kind) {
    if (!this.operator) throw new Error("debugSpawnFx: operator not ready");
    const dir = this.camera.getWorldDirection(new THREE.Vector3());
    dir.y = 0;

# Browser
## Stop: choose the right surface before any browser action

Explicit browser intent wins: if the user names the in-app browser or Chrome, or asks to open, show, or navigate to a page; inspect its visual or interactive state; or interact with its UI, continue with Browser and do not substitute a connector.

Otherwise, treat a URL or open browser tab as context, not browser intent. Earlier Browser use does not make later semantic work browser-first. Before each semantic operation on a linked resource, you MUST query available and deferred tools for an applicable connector, API, or CLI. Reading this skill or scanning visible tools does not count. Do not initialize Browser for that operation until the query is complete. Use the non-browser tool when available. If it handles the current operation, continue the larger workflow without Browser for that operation. Use Browser when no such tool exists, the tool cannot access the resource or lacks a required capability, or UI work remains; use available browser context before asking the user to repeat it.

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

## Setup Documentation
Use `await agent.documentation.get("<name>")` when one of these setup topics applies:
- `bootstrap-troubleshooting`: read when browser setup succeeds but discovery or selection fails
- `chrome-troubleshooting`: read when Chrome extension setup, installation, or communication fails

## Bootstrap
These setup details are internal. User-facing progress updates should be less technical in nature. Never mention `Node REPL`, `node_repl`, `REPL`, JavaScript sessions, module exports, reading documentation, or loading instructions unless a user is asking for that exact information. If setup or recovery is needed, describe it naturally as connecting to the browser or retrying the browser connection.

The `browser-client` module is the core entry point for browser use, and is available under `scripts/browser-client.mjs` in this plugin's root directory. ALWAYS import it using an absolute path. IMPORTANT: If this path cannot be found, stop and report that this plugin is missing `scripts/browser-client.mjs`. NEVER use the built in `browser-client` library.

Run browser setup code through the Node REPL `js` tool. In this environment the callable tool id typically appears as `mcp__node_repl__js`. If it is not already available, use tool discovery for `node_repl js` without setting a result limit. You need the `js` execution tool: `js_reset` only clears state, and `js_add_node_module_dir` only changes package resolution. Do not call either helper while trying to expose `js`. If `js` is still not available, search again for `node_repl js` with `limit: 10`.

Initialize the runtime once per fresh Node session. If `agent.browsers` already exists, reuse it; do not import or initialize another browser runtime.

```js
if (globalThis.agent?.browsers == null) {
  const { setupBrowserRuntime } = await import("<plugin root>/scripts/browser-client.mjs");
  await setupBrowserRuntime({ globals: globalThis });
}
```

Once a browser connection is established, reuse its existing browser binding across later turns and do not reread this skill. Once you have read a browser's complete documentation, do not read it again unless you select a different browser.

A tab binding is separate from its browser binding. If a later turn reports that a tab is missing, stale, closed, or not part of the current browser session, discard that tab binding and obtain or create a fresh tab from the existing browser binding. An empty `browser.tabs.list()` or `browser.user.openTabs()` result is normal after tab cleanup and does not invalidate the browser binding. Never call `agent.browsers.get*` to recover a tab; only an explicit browser-disconnected error invalidates the binding.

## Browser selection

The scenarios below are for the initial browser selection only. Before calling any `agent.browsers.get*` method, reuse an existing `globalThis.browser`, `globalThis.iab`, or `globalThis.chrome` binding that already serves the task. A new user turn does not invalidate a browser binding or require another selection or documentation call.

Select the initial browser with exactly one of these scenarios, in the order
shown. An explicit request for the in-app browser or Chrome always wins over URL
selection. Never call `getForUrl()` when the user names a browser.

App-provided in-app-browser context is ambient UI state, not a user instruction to select or switch browsers. Only the text of the user's request can explicitly choose a browser.

Do not inspect browser cookies, local storage, profiles, passwords, or session stores. Browser discovery must remain read-only.

When authentication blocks requested browser navigation, do not replace it with web search, a search engine, another site, or another source merely to bypass sign-in.

### The user explicitly requests a browser

A plugin mention in the user's request explicitly names its browser.
`[@Browser](plugin://browser@openai-bundled)` names the in-app browser.
`[@Chrome](plugin://chrome@openai-bundled)`,
`[@chrome-internal](plugin://chrome-internal@openai-bundled)`, and
`[@chrome-dev](plugin://chrome-dev@openai-bundled)` name Chrome. Follow the
corresponding explicit-browser scenario below.

The in-app browser is available only when the Browser skill is listed for the session. If the user explicitly requests the in-app browser and that skill is available, use a distinct persistent binding and immediately read its complete documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.iab == null) {
  globalThis.iab = await agent.browsers.get("iab");
  nodeRepl.write(await iab.documentation());
}
```

If the user explicitly requests the in-app browser but the Browser skill is not available, report that the in-app browser is unavailable instead of substituting another browser.

Chrome is available only when the Chrome skill is listed for the session. If the user explicitly requests Chrome and that skill is available, use a separate persistent binding and immediately read its complete documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.chrome == null) {
  globalThis.chrome = await agent.browsers.get("extension");
  nodeRepl.write(await chrome.documentation());
}
```

If the user explicitly requests Chrome but the Chrome skill is not available, report that Chrome is unavailable instead of substituting another browser.

An explicit browser choice remains in force for the task. If authentication blocks the task in an explicitly selected browser, your next response must explicitly ask the user to sign in in that browser and tell you when it is ready, unless that browser's documentation provides a supported authentication flow to try first. Merely reporting that sign-in is required is not sufficient. Do not switch to another browser unless the user asks or approves the switch.

### The task requires browser interaction, the user does not specify a browser, and the task has a target URL

When the user supplies a URL or the intended URL can be reasonably inferred from the request, replace the example below with that URL and let browser-client choose the browser best suited to it:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.getForUrl("https://example.com/");
  nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
}
```

### The user specifies neither a browser nor a target URL

Use the runtime default, which prefers the in-app browser when it is available and otherwise uses Chrome. Do not list browsers first:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.getDefault();
  nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
}
```

## After setup

If setup succeeds but browser discovery or selection fails, read `await agent.documentation.get("bootstrap-troubleshooting")` before resetting the JavaScript session or trying another browser-control mechanism.

If the failure is specific to Chrome extension setup, installation, or communication, read `await agent.documentation.get("chrome-troubleshooting")` before retrying or taking another recovery action.

When the user did not explicitly choose a browser, a browser selected by the runtime is not a user constraint. Do not switch browsers based only on an assumption about authentication. If navigation shows that the selected browser lacks the required authentication, select another available browser before asking the user to sign in. You may select it without resetting the Node session. Preserve existing `iab`, `chrome`, and `browser` bindings when they are still useful. Existing tabs remain bound to the browser that created them. After selecting a different browser, obtain a tab from that browser before continuing and read its complete documentation.

The ability to interact directly with browsers is exposed through the `browser-client` runtime via the `agent.browsers.*` API. Before trying to interact with a selected browser for the first time, you MUST emit and read the complete documentation returned by its `documentation()` call in one go. For the initial documentation read, run the exact direct `nodeRepl.write(await <browser>.documentation());` call shown in the applicable scenario above. Do not assign the documentation to a variable, inspect its length, slice it, truncate it, summarize it, or emit only an excerpt. Do not proactively split the documentation into pages or chunks. Only if the tool output itself explicitly reports that it was truncated may you emit and read smaller chunks until you have read the documentation in its entirety.

Only the Node REPL `js` tool (`mcp__node_repl__js`) can be used to control the selected browser. Do not use external MCP browser-control tools, separate browser automation servers, or other browser skills for this surface. References to Playwright mean the in-skill `tab.playwright` API after browser-client setup.

# 三角洲专属靶场 Demo 0.1

面向《三角洲行动》的本地 WebGL 练枪场原型。首发支持 AS Val、M250、M14、M7，以及四类训练：

- 静态点击
- 平滑/反应追踪
- 多目标切换
- 压枪墙

## 启动

```powershell
npm install
npm run dev
```

浏览器访问终端显示的本地地址。生产构建：

```powershell
npm test
npm run build
```

四枪美术验证页：

```text
/kimi-art-review.html
```

该页面是对 Kimi Code CLI 的 blockout 设计意图进行的浏览器重建，可切换 AS Val、M250、M14、M7，检查 PBR/灰模/黑色剪影、Godot Marker、换弹拆件与程序化动作。它不是 Blender 导出文件，也不代表已经产出正式 GLB、贴图、LOD、骨骼或动画。

参考图返工版已额外导出四个可导入中模 GLB：

```text
public/assets/kimi-v2/asval-kimi-v2.glb
public/assets/kimi-v2/m250-kimi-v2.glb
public/assets/kimi-v2/m14-kimi-v2.glb
public/assets/kimi-v2/m7-kimi-v2.glb
```

这些GLB保留换弹拆件节点，但仍未包含正式UV贴图、LOD、骨骼动画或经过Godot校准的插槽。

## 真实数据链路（ADS / 开火特效）

```text
extracted/weapon_ads.json + weapon_fx.json + fx_curves.json + fx_particles.json
  + parsed/WeaponAppearance_WeaponFiringAnimTable.csv + part_ads_visibility.json
    ── extracted/gen_range_fx.py ──▶ range/src/data/weapon_fx.js（曲线烘焙 64 点 LUT）
```

- `core/ads-motion.js`：每枪 adsOn/adsOff/sideOn/sideOff 秒数驱动 ADS/战术据枪进程，
  adsCurve（枪身位姿）、camFovCurve（相机 FOV 形状）、wpnFovCurve（武器 FOV≈viewmodel 缩放）三路混合；
  机瞄/红点放大率用每枪 zoomRate（多为 1.25）；ADS 过半隐藏 part_ads_visibility 标的小零件。
- `visual/fire_fx.js`：枪口火光（每枪真实贴图，`_MMxNN_` 图集贴图做 subUV 翻页，开镜换 Zoom 版）
  + 瞬时点光、程序化抛壳（池 40）、曳光（按 trailProbability）、镜头抖动（fireShake 曲线/振荡器）、
  枪身后踢（FiringAnim pos/rot 曲线 × ScaleArray 逐发强度，缺失时 gunkick 表回退）。全部对象池化。
- 数据缺失的枪静默回退 `weapon_fx.js` 全局 defaults；openSightOnFire 在已提取的 64 枪中全为 true，未做特殊处理。
- 调试 URL：`?weapon=m7&ads=1`、`?fire=1`（自动连发）、`?fx=0`（关特效）、`?fxhold=1`（火光定格截图）、
  `?laser=1`（无配装强制镭射）、`?clean=1`（隐藏菜单遮罩）。

## 瞄准镜渲染（visual/scope_pip.js）：默认 zoom 全屏放大，PiP 镜内放大为实验项

- **zoom（默认，游戏原版行为）= 全屏 FOV 放大**：开镜后主相机 FOV = hipFov/当前倍率档
  （`zoomAdsFov`，纯函数可测；XM157 1.5×→hipFov/1.5、7×→hipFov/7），DOM 分划叠加居中
  （tickmark 反色+reticle 亮点，SFP 不随档缩放）；单倍红点/机瞄 = hipFov/1.25（真实 zoomRate）。
  变倍：V 键 / 滚轮循环 SupportedZoomRates 档位（两种模式都生效），HUD 底部显示当前倍率；
  灵敏度分档（设置面板分倍镜项）两种模式都按当前倍率档（`currentAdsZoom`）。
- **pip（设置面板「镜内放大（实验）」）**：副相机（眼位、FOV=镜片角直径/当前倍率档）
  渲 WebGLRenderTarget（默认 1024²，设置可调 512/2048），贴在镜片位置的圆形 quad 上——放大画面"长在镜子上"，
  有视差；**主相机不缩 FOV**，镜外世界保持原 FOV、枪身同框。
  分划（tickmark+reticle 贴图，CrosshairPreset 颜色/缩放）合成 additive quad 画进镜内；镜缘暗角径向渐变 quad。
  开火时分划按 sco_pair RandomKick_SightOffset 在镜内跳动（数据 `public/scope_pair_kick.json`，懒加载，缺失回退 55‰）。
- **镜片锚点 = 游戏 socket 数据对位**（不是包围盒估计）：`WeaponPartsMeshSocketNameInfo` 的
  **Center/Eyec_Point** socket（全 103 个瞄具网格都有；PSO 上 Center==Eyec_Point 实证 Center 即目镜光心），
  经 `gunsmith_data.js meshSockets[瞄具网格]` 取用，glb-assembly 解算为装配空间坐标写 `userData.scopeLensCenter`；
  包围盒链（玻璃网格→镜身盒→Sco_point）仅作无数据回退。镜片半径 = 镜片网格在瞄具局部空间横截面 (x+y)/4
  （XM157 玻璃管直径 0.0377 → 0.0189 ≈ ScoFunctionTable ScoRadius 1.81cm；半径字段未导出到 gunsmith_data，故用网格量）。
  ADS mount 用目镜光心 + **ADS 到位缩放**（base×aimWeaponFov/idleWeaponFov）反解——按 base 缩放解会让镜体低
  (1-k)×锚高（M7+XM157 实测低 4.7cm，镜片圆盘浮在镜筒上方的根因）。
  玻璃材质 `depthWrite:false`（否则透明玻璃写深度，镜内 additive 准星点被深度挡掉——红点不可见的根因）。
- **枪×镜 pair 参数**：`gen_range_scopes.py` 将 `sco_pair.json` 按瞄具懒加载写入
  `scopes/{itemId}.json#pairOverrides`；`scope_pip.js` 用当前武器 `recId` 选择组合，已消费
  `FixedOffsetScale`、`LayoutOffsetWPS`、`AimingIdle_SightOffset`，并优先直接使用 pair
  `RandomKick_SightOffset`。其余 Cam/Sight/FOV、逐轴开火动画与 SpringKick 字段已保留在数据包，
  待对应运行时通道完成后继续接线。
- **红点/全息（ZoomRate≤1.25）**：不放大，镜片内 6mm 深处放 additive 准星点（数据无贴图时程序生成，颜色 reticleColor；
  大小 = clamp(reticleScale×0.4, 0.05, 0.12) × 镜片半径），ADS 可见、腰射隐藏；主相机 FOV 按 1.25 缩放（两种模式一致）。
- **分层**：viewmodel（枪身/火光 sprite/镜片 quad 自身）在 layer 1，PiP 副相机只看 layer 0（环境），防反馈回路；
  主相机 0|1 都开。RT 只在 ADS（adsBlend>0.05）且倍镜时每帧渲一次。
- **回退**：RT 创建失败/找不到镜片网格时静默回退 zoom 全屏放大。镜片锚点沿视轴前推（相机嵌入镜身尾部时）
  并按开镜进程收向相机轴线。旧设置值 `dom` 自动迁移为 `zoom`。
- 调试 URL：`?scope=<itemId>`（无枪匠配装也装瞄具，如 13110000082=XM157 / 13110000046=SRS-02红点 / 13110000091=灵眼3/7）、
  `?zstep=N`（变倍档序号）、`?pip=0`（强制 zoom）、`?pip=1`（强制 PiP）、`?pipfov=N`（固定副相机 FOV）、
  `?pipdebug=1`（状态写 DOM，配合 --dump-dom）。

改数据后重建：`python extracted/gen_range_fx.py && cd range && npm run build`。

## 第一人称全身身体（3P → 1P）

- `visual/range_body.js` 独立加载 `char_models.js` 的 `full` 3P 全身 GLB，挂到玩家 `yawRig`；
  身体随玩家位移/水平转向，但不继承相机俯仰，因此低头时可看到保持竖直的腹部、髋部和双腿。
- 运行时裁掉相机附近的头、胸肩和双臂三角形，避免相机吞面黑屏，也避免与枪/刀/技能的
  1P 手臂 viewmodel 重叠；身体与武器同属 `VM_LAYER`，不会进入瞄具 PiP 的环境副相机。
- 3P 原始 MRA/MRO 贴图在身体材质 shader 中完成 R/B 通道适配；`*_orm` 贴图直接走
  three.js 标准 ORM 布局。身体骨架保留为 `SkinnedMesh`，逐帧从 bind pose 叠加待机呼吸、
  走/跑/冲刺交替步态、侧移重心、髋部 bob 与蹲姿屈膝；停止或换皮时会恢复基准骨骼，不残留腿部姿势。
  由于当前仅有 AR_M_1P 的 1P 骨骼动画数据，且其坐标空间与 3P 身体不兼容，因此不会误绑该剪辑造成
  腿部拉到地下。
- 设置面板「显示第一人称身体」可单独关闭；人物切换会同步切换 3P 身体。只有 1P 上半身资产的
  扩展角色会回退同角色已导出的 3P 本体，否则回退 `C_Test_001_3P`，不会出现“只有手臂没有腿”。
- 调试：`?enter=1&clean=1&pulldown=80&bodydebug=1`，身体资产、可见性、姿态与
  当前 `animation`/`motionBlend` 写入
  `#viewport[data-body]`，便于无头截图/DOM 断言。

## 烽火地带弹药 / 护甲 / TTK

```text
extracted/ammo.json（枪基础伤害链+弹药表）+ gunsmith/gunsmith_data.json（recId→shortName）
  ── extracted/gen_range_ammo.py ──▶ range/src/data/ammo_data.js（103 枪：baseDamage/baseArmorDamage/部位倍率/初速/衰减节点+弹药明细）
```

- HUD 右下弹药选择器：当前枪可用弹药（中文名+穿透等级+伤害倍率），默认第一发（低穿），选择按枪持久化（localStorage `delta-range-ammo-v1`）。
- 命中结算：肉伤 = baseDamage × damageRate × 部位倍率 × 距离衰减（衰减节点线性插值，M7 为 70m→0.9/1000m→0.8）；甲伤 = baseArmorDamage × armorDamageRate × 衰减；四肢再乘 limbsDamageRate。
- 靶子带护甲（设置面板 0~6 级，默认 3，耐久=等级×25）。**简化穿透规则**（非游戏真实公式）：穿透≥护甲 → 肉伤全额+甲伤扣耐久；穿透<护甲 → 肉伤×0.5+甲伤×2；耐久打空视同无甲。
- 浮动伤害数字：肉伤白 / 甲伤黄（池化 16 个）；压枪墙上显示理论胸口肉伤（读衰减用）。
- 击杀显示 TTK（首次命中→击杀）+ 命中发数（HUD 右下"上次击杀"区）；靶子 0.35s 倒地后 2s 重生。
- 无弹药档案的枪静默回退旧伤害链（`effectiveDamage`）。

## 战术设备（镭射/手电）

- 判定：配装配件名含"激光|镭射"→镭射，含"手电|电筒"→手电（"激光手电"两者皆是）；gunsmith-build 的 partIds 用于在装配模型里找设备 mesh 原点，找不到回退枪口下沿。
